verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a marketing tagline about team collaboration and a note that Unity Build Automation works with popular version control systems. This suggests team and VCS-aware tooling, but nothing documents how the project format itself behaves under version control. Missing for 10: documentation of text-serialized or diffable scene/asset formats, scene merge tooling, a named built-in version control or collaboration product, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-person workflows.

support.subject: As a studio lead, the project format and tooling play well with version control and multi-person teams — mergeable scenes, diffable text formats, or built-in collaboration

citations.quote: Collaborate and iterate quickly with your team
Build Automation supports most popular version control systems
